Game Gear cartridge shell, silhouette, interior and circuit board adapted from nelynes/slotPlus, commit 0e85ed2b82dd1baf57ac10139c25f58a2365c09e.
The source artwork and its generator are at https://github.com/nelynes/slotPlus/tree/0e85ed2b82dd1baf57ac10139c25f58a2365c09e/assets .
